question: Which Indian athlete did not win a Gold medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anshu Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anshu Malik**, an Indian freestyle wrestler, won a **silver medal** in the **57kg category** at the **2022 Commonwealth Games** (CWG). She did not win a gold medal, making her the correct answer.
 
• **Mirabai Chanu**, an Indian weightlifter, won the **gold medal** in the **49kg weightlifting category** at the 2022 CWG. Hence, this option is incorrect.
 
• **P.V. Sindhu**, a celebrated Indian badminton player, clinched the **gold medal** in the **women's singles badminton event** at the 2022 CWG. Hence, this option is incorrect.
